data.note: Each version runs on its own Neon database branch. A version is kept when it reproduces its answer key, tests the same skill, and isn't already online. The agent solve rate is shown for information.

lanes.label: Version 1 · new numbers
lanes.stem: Two fair four-sided dice, each with faces numbered 1 through 4, are rolled at the same time. What is the probability that the product of the two rolled numbers is strictly greater than 6?
lanes.reason: agent solve rate 1/1 valid runs (95% CI 21%-100%), for information

lanes.label: Version 2 · real-world setting
lanes.stem: In a telecommunications quality lab, two independent micro-servers are tested simultaneously. Each server is assigned an integer load rating from 1 to 4 (with each rating equally likely). A technician flags a test run as 'Optimal' if the combined load rating of the two servers equals 5. Each test run takes 45 seconds to complete. What is the probability that a randomly executed test run is flagged as 'Optimal'?
lanes.reason: agent solve rate 1/1 valid runs (95% CI 21%-100%), for information
